basis: The printing heads this gloss 'VERS. 1.' and it opens 'Vers. 1. Peregrinatus est in Geraris. Geraris terra | est Palaestinorum.'. The printing's caput and the lemma's own words, matched against the Clementine, name the same chapter.
date_basis: Remigius taught at Reims and then at Paris and died about 908. His scriptural commentaries are products of that teaching and are not separately dated; the range covers the years in which he taught. The date is the writing, not Migne's 1853 printing.
text: Vers. 1. Peregrinatus est in Geraris. Geraris terra | est Palaestinorum.
